title: Withdrawal Fee and Limit Schedule for the Pocketwire Savings Vault
content:
The schedule sets, for each Pocketwire Savings Vault tier, the free withdrawals per vault, the fee on each withdrawal beyond them, the daily withdrawal cap, the hold on deposits funded from an external bank, and whether and how quickly a withdrawal can go to a linked bank.

## Schedule

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free withdrawals per vault per calendar month | 3 | 6 | 6 | 10 | 20 | 50 |
| Excess withdrawal fee, each withdrawal beyond the free count | $5.00 | $5.00 | $3.00 | $2.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Cap on withdrawals from the customer's vaults on one calendar day | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 |
| Hold on a deposit funded from an external bank | 5 calendar days | 5 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 1 calendar day | 0 calendar days |
| Withdrawal straight to a linked bank | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Latest arrival of a withdrawal to a linked bank | 3 business days | 3 business days | 3 business days | 2 business days | 2 business days | 1 business day |

## Notes

- **Free withdrawals** are counted per vault and per calendar month; they are not pooled across a customer's vaults.
- **Daily cap** applies to the total of the day's withdrawals across all of the customer's vaults.
- **Deposit hold.** The figure is the number of calendar days a deposit funded from an external bank stays unavailable for withdrawal. Pocketwire Vault Private shows 0 calendar days, so such a deposit carries no hold on that tier.
- **Linked bank.** Where the schedule shows No, a withdrawal cannot go straight to a linked bank and goes to the personal balance; the arrival figure matters only on the tiers showing Yes.
- **Fee of $0.00.** On Pocketwire Vault Reserve and Pocketwire Vault Private the fee on a withdrawal beyond the free count is $0.00.
